newFindingsResolved.issue: Inherited recordRef values such as toString/__proto__ passed a prototype lookup and crashed studentPanels.
newFindingsResolved.fix: Object.hasOwn on the projection records plus a null-prototype evidence dictionary.

newFindingsResolved.issue: Retracted/superseded/conflicted completion and assignment history was displayed as current checked work.
newFindingsResolved.fix: Conservative exclusion of retracted/superseded records and conflicted state without a completion check; raw history remains readable.

newFindingsResolved.issue: Unsupported request/membership sessions could silently yield no cohort.
newFindingsResolved.fix: Only all, 1 and 2 are admitted for requested sessions; membership slots outside 1/2 remain unverified.

newFindingsResolved.issue: A failed renderer after changing selected student could leave the prior student record list under the new heading.
newFindingsResolved.fix: Selection commit invalidates/aborts record requests and clears the old record panel before mounting the new student.

newFindingsResolved.issue: Server summary sizes could exceed the client 200-entry contract and blank otherwise valid imported histories.
newFindingsResolved.fix: Assignment/checklist summaries capped at 100 each and supporting evidence at 200, with explicit visible count/partial coverage and paged raw-record availability.

newFindingsResolved.issue: Withdrawn/superseded/conflicted workflow policies or memberships could remain current selections/class members.
newFindingsResolved.fix: Conservative history exclusion/unverified membership and correction-sensitive catalog/membership revision digests.

reverifiedBaselineControls: Unauthenticated preview requires the single exact packaged fixture envelope and is rechecked on every protected request; an imported synthetic label cannot confer access.
SQLite imports enforce one owner and one mode inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE; identity/evidence joins and immutable record/dataset conflicts are rejected atomically.
All operational data/static routes require configured owner authentication in owner mode; only non-sensitive health is public.
Socket loopback, exact Host/Origin, cross-site fetch and unconfigured forwarding headers enforce the boundary. Platform identity and query tokens do not authenticate.
Authentication comparison hashes submitted values to a fixed-size SHA-256 digest then uses timingSafeEqual. Real secret-file loading and operational auth lifecycle were not exercised.
HTTP APIs are GET/HEAD-only; SQL inputs are parameterized; static serving is an exact three-file map; artifact bytes and archive paths are not served.
Renderer dynamic content uses escaping or textContent; restored panels do not grant execution authority from source context.
Private no-store, same-origin resource policy, restrictive CSP, no CORS allowance and bounded generic failure responses remain in place.
restoredSurfaces: Book rails, teacher overlay, included-content placement and desktop stepper.
Student current-report view, Today saved-summary view, date/session workflow policy view, evidence view, empty-assessment/diary view and unavailable refresh-readiness view.
New independent GET read models with owner/student scope and explicit absence of live source proof.

knownFunctionalLimits.detail: Five purpose-written fictional students and 144 fictional source records only. No existing private student archive has been normalized, reconciled or imported.

Projects recognized teacher_assignment and activity_checkpoint records. Attendance, schedule, richer stage events and many old domain mappings remain empty/unprojected; original raw records remain separately accessible. Conservative history suppression does not prove semantic reconciliation.

Returns current.state=unverified and an all-owner saved event summary. It does not establish the requested date/session actual tasks, DailyRecord completion, attendance or today-specific source freshness.

Projects recognized workflow_policy steps as contains relations and recognized membership patterns. It does not reconstruct the complete historical policy graph, preconditions, role/artifact/dependency relations, confirmed binding ledger or actual execution tasks.

Actual assessment/attempt records are not projected; their presence is surfaced as unprojected instead of a false empty assessment. Only recognized saved diary rows are shown. Authentic student identity, source clocks and complete record coverage require migration work.

Seventeen domain buttons count/filter stored records; these categories do not establish that all academy workflows or actions are implemented. Generic raw-record next pages are available through the API rather than a complete UI pager.

Independent Node/SQLite auth/read contracts replace hosted Sites trust. Prior POST contracts and native browser modelContext registration are not reproduced. Historical UI appearance does not establish old API, data or functional parity.

No source live login/read refresh adapter, source mutations, printing, sending, actual distribution, artifact byte serving, private-import command, full backup/restore flow or external deployment is implemented/verified.

hardRemainingGates.requirement: Inventory approved source records, namespaces, attachments, conflicts and unavailable data. Independently reconcile source identities, record counts, projection mappings and correction history before real import.
Use separately approved secure operational authentication setup. Real secret loading, browser Basic-auth handling, rotation/revocation and local multi-user operating assumptions need testing.
Use a separate private database/archive outside source fixtures/bundles; screen secrets/tokens/signed URLs, validate artifact bytes/hashes, and verify repository/recipient access.
Test consistent SQLite/WAL backups, restore, corruption recovery, import rollback and storage migration on the selected operational deployment.
Design/verify TLS, access management, secrets, logging, abuse controls and explicit proxy trust before any external hosting. Current external-bind rejection must not be bypassed casually.
Restore and test missing actual data/domain semantics before claiming complete feature parity or all academy work. Restored panels and category catalogues are not sufficient.
Associate this runtime digest with the final frozen tree/archive/commit and rehash after packaging. Any changed runtime file invalidates the verdict until rechecked.

limitations: Bounded independent static review plus synthetic local tests, not a blanket security guarantee.
No complete GUI/browser-security-engine validation, adversarial filesystem/OS attacker, production load or real private data test.
Read models fail closed above 10000 queried records; large-history scalability and total graph cost remain operational limits.
Freshness maxima currently use serialized timestamp ordering and require validation with real mixed-offset/source-clock data before operational interpretation.
No external dependency advisory scan was performed. Runtime requires native Node only; development tools remain separate pinned dependencies.
Archive/runtime provenance and factual source identity must not be treated as authorization or evidence of successful academy action.
